verdict.rationale: Gmail documents standard IMAP and POP access for non-Gmail clients, and its API lists read-only mail extraction, backup, and email account migration as use cases, with messages in RFC 2822 MIME format. Together these give a path to take mail out in open formats. However, no first-party bulk export of all account data is documented, and a hands-on report says Gmail's own export tools fail for 100GB+ inboxes, so third-party tools are needed. missing for 10: documented first-party full-account export tool, coverage of non-mail data (contacts, labels, settings) in open formats, evidence that export works reliably for large inboxes.
